inventory.selection: Ten highest-priority remaining exact-model candidate price gaps in fresh inventory order after excluding the ten B147 targets and same-day-researched models. Carbonda CFR707 is excluded because its latest price attempt is temporarily exhausted until 2026-11-17. Ten candidate records and ten atomic price fields are frozen.

scope.research_boundary: Use the user's single Luna evidence-only researcher; root remains sole writer. Before opening any result page, inspect all linked source, attempt, campaign and source_url histories for that exact model; exact-literal search the proposed final URL across repository data and docs. If present or pre-open absence cannot be proven, skip without reopening. Per target: at most one distinct exact-model web query and one genuinely new product/seller page.
price_rules: For price-missing fields, record only dated exact-model public manufacturer or seller prices with their type and basis; a request-a-quote form without an actual amount does not fill a price gap.

For price-not-observed fields, require current exact-build mainland CNY transaction or seller-listing evidence. An MSRP, subsidy, coupon estimate, global USD conversion, foreign-market amount, search snippet, seller-family result or unclear selected option is not an observed price.
Preserve selected model, generation, build/package, seller, date and conditional terms. Do not infer authorization, stock, shipping, tax, warranty, returns or final checkout.
One distinct query per exact target. Reuse existing sources without reopening; do not retry inaccessible pages. No login, quote submission, seller contact, cart, purchase or hidden checkout probing.
excluded: No agent edits; no XHS/Weibo, personal browser, login/CAPTCHA, external message, seller outreach, quote/cart/purchase, image download/rehosting or delivery action.
No updates outside the ten frozen price fields, supporting source records, research attempt records and dated batch documentation.
